entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The moment was punctuated by the ar..."
entries.dialogueText: The moment was punctuated by the arrival of a member of the Golden Guard. He was wearing a ceremonial breastplate that gleamed under the room's warm lights.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""War is a crucible. If you can face..."
entries.dialogueText: "War is a crucible. If you can face it head-on and survive, you will be unbreakable."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We must also remember the toll con..."
entries.dialogueText: "We must also remember the toll conflict takes on our people. History should recall the hearts and spirits of those brave commoners sent to fight for their kingdom."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But what if it's all too much? Wha..."
entries.dialogueText: "But what if it's all too much? What if I fail?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Lord is on our side. Our victo..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Lord is on our side. Our victory will not only be a testament to our strength but also to our faith and righteousness."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""'Crucible' is a fitting word for i..."
entries.dialogueText: "'Crucible' is a fitting word for it. I will lead our kingdom to battle with an iron fist. All will know Rizia's might."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hoped it would never come to thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hoped it would never come to this. But if we must weather the storm of war, I shall do my best to steer Rizia through it."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Calm and thoughtful leadership is..."
entries.dialogueText: "Calm and thoughtful leadership is what Rizia needs right now."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""All these metaphors are making me..."
entries.dialogueText: "All these metaphors are making me seasick. I just hope history doesn't repeat itself."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Compassion is noble, but it must n..."
entries.dialogueText: "Compassion is noble, but it must not overshadow the need for decisive action in times of war."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I disagree. If we lose our moral c..."
entries.dialogueText: "I disagree. If we lose our moral compass, then we lose everything."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Decisiveness is key. But I won't l..."
entries.dialogueText: "Decisiveness is key. But I won't let it harden our kingdom's heart."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're right. It's up to me to mak..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're right. It's up to me to make the tough but necessary decisions."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Two and a half million people have..."
entries.dialogueText: "Two and a half million people have gathered outside. Our entire police force is deployed for their safety."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The Golden Guard will ensure the p..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Golden Guard will ensure the palace and its surroundings remain secure."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I suspect it was always going to c..."
entries.dialogueText: "I suspect it was always going to come to this, Your Highness. You shouldn't blame yourself."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Exactly. You were lucky to get out..."
entries.dialogueText: "Exactly. You were lucky to get out of there alive."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If anything, it was my actions tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "If anything, it was my actions that led us to this point. But now that we've set ourselves on this path, we can't turn back."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There's no use lamenting what coul..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's no use lamenting what could have been. We've got to concentrate on what comes next."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Your solidarity is admirable, Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your solidarity is admirable, Your Highness, but there are some decisions your father will have to make on his own."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The mantle of leadership is a soli..."
entries.dialogueText: "The mantle of leadership is a solitary one. But the choices you make will affect every living soul in this kingdom."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""We will not win this war without f..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will not win this war without faith, Your Highness. But it must be combined with clear-headed strategy."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""For as long as I live, our family..."
entries.dialogueText: "For as long as I live, our family will be safe."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Strength is a tool, Your Highness...."
entries.dialogueText: "Strength is a tool, Your Highness. One that can be valuable if used judiciously."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Precisely, Your Highness. We don't..."
entries.dialogueText: "Precisely, Your Highness. We don't want our kingdom to be perceived as the aggressor."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Facing Pales is our chance to corr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Facing Pales is our chance to correct past mistakes, not repeat them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you nonetheless, Vina. I'll..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you nonetheless, Vina. I'll never turn away from the wisdom of my family and council."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's all part and parcel of being..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's all part and parcel of being king. I was born to rule alone."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes. For now.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. For now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Only I can protect our nation in t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Only I can protect our nation in these trying times."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The weight of this war rests solel..."
entries.dialogueText: "The weight of this war rests solely on me, a responsibility I must accept for Rizia's safety."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We need to defend our kingdom's so..."
entries.dialogueText: "We need to defend our kingdom's sovereignty and future."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our faith will bolster us, but our..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our faith will bolster us, but our strategy against Pales will be pragmatic and calculated."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is Rizia's destiny to reunite w..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is Rizia's destiny to reunite with Pales. If we pray enough, we will manifest our victory."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My head is clearer than it's ever..."
entries.dialogueText: "My head is clearer than it's ever been. I know God will show us the way forward."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We seek comfort in prayer, but our..."
entries.dialogueText: "We seek comfort in prayer, but our decisive actions will be what protects Rizia from the Palesian menace."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Palesians brought this on them..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Palesians brought this on themselves. They deserve all the destruction we can rain down on them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Palesians have given us no cho..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Palesians have given us no choice, Vina. It's now or never."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I swear on my own life that no har..."
entries.dialogueText: "I swear on my own life that no harm shall befall the Toras family."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We aren't bound by our past as we..."
entries.dialogueText: "We aren't bound by our past as we confront Pales. We will forge a new path for Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our strength will be a shield, not..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our strength will be a shield, not a weapon of oppression."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will do what I must to protect o..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will do what I must to protect our people. No matter how painful the decision."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our history with Pales is a guide...."
entries.dialogueText: "Our history with Pales is a guide. We'll use it to avoid repeating old errors."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In war, we shall remain calm, our..."
entries.dialogueText: "In war, we shall remain calm, our actions swift and decisive."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But we don't want to be seen as we..."
entries.dialogueText: "But we don't want to be seen as weaklings, either."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Controlled strength. That's what I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Controlled strength. That's what I'm aiming for in this speech."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know exactly what my father did..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know exactly what my father did wrong. I'll never fall into the same traps he did."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We won't repeat history, we'll rew..."
entries.dialogueText: "We won't repeat history, we'll rewrite it. Starting today."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I have been outside. The atmospher..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have been outside. The atmosphere is tense, yet there's an undeniable sense of solidarity among our people."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Look at how prepared we are, Madam..."
entries.dialogueText: "Look at how prepared we are, Madam Queen Mother. Our armies will not falter."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I remember this feeling from all t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I remember this feeling from all the way back in 1923. And I remember what happened next..."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Listen to me, Romus. We can't lose..."
entries.dialogueText: "Listen to me, Romus. We can't lose to Pales again."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I just hope that less blood will b..."
entries.dialogueText: "I just hope that less blood will be spilled than during the Reclamation War."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I just hope that we can find a pea..."
entries.dialogueText: "I just hope that we can find a peaceful resolution to this. Sooner rather than later."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The rhythmic cadence of countless v..."
entries.dialogueText: The rhythmic cadence of countless voices echoed outside.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Pacifying the Palesian populace wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Pacifying the Palesian populace will lead to the least harm. That is our goal."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The Palesians don't want peace, Yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Palesians don't want peace, Your Highness. Furthering the cycle of violence allows them to garner more support from their Lespian backers."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He relayed to Hugo that all was pre..."
entries.dialogueText: He relayed to Hugo that all was prepared. The time had come to address the Kingdom, to define the future of Rizia at war.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We'll aim to pacify Pales, but not..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll aim to pacify Pales, but not at the expense of our humanity."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Pacification should not mean oppre..."
entries.dialogueText: "Pacification should not mean oppression. We'll ensure fairness in our approach."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Choose your words carefully, son...."
entries.dialogueText: "Choose your words carefully, son. This speech isn't just about the war; it's about rallying the Rizian people in the face of adversity."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our goal is peace, but we must be..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our goal is peace, but we must be ready for resistance."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am confident that Duke Reinhart..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am confident that Duke Reinhart wants a swift end to the war, just as I do."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We are not going to fall into that..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are not going to fall into that trap. We'll choose the path of peace at all costs."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We're facing a harsh reality. We m..."
entries.dialogueText: "We're facing a harsh reality. We must be ready for whatever violence comes."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Just don't forget that less-than-d..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just don't forget that less-than-decisive action on our part risks drawing out the conflict further and losing more lives."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're right, Mother. This speech..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're right, Mother. This speech is a call to unity, a reminder that we are stronger together."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's a chance to remind them what..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's a chance to remind them what they'll be fighting for. What they'll be dying for."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll use this speech to lift our p..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll use this speech to lift our people's spirits. Rizia will only win this war if they believe we can."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""For king and country.""
entries.dialogueText: "For king and country."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Everything has been prepared for y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Everything has been prepared for you. Would you like any of us to be by your side on the balcony?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You are all family. I want you by..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are all family. I want you by my side."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Princess Vina represents the futur..."
entries.dialogueText: "Princess Vina represents the future. She should be with me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our Queen Mother should be next to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our Queen Mother should be next to me to show that we survived the past tribulations."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You should be with me, Hugo. As my..."
entries.dialogueText: "You should be with me, Hugo. As my uncle and my trusted second-in-command."
